name: Velvet
css: .popover, .popover.sheet { box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px oklch(83% 0.1 82 / 0.32), inset 0 0 0 5px var(--docent-bg), inset 0 0 0 6px oklch(83% 0.1 82 / 0.2), var(--docent-shadow); } .popover .arrow { border-color: oklch(83% 0.1 82 / 0.32) !important; } .title { font-family: 'Iowan Old Style', 'Palatino Linotype', Palatino, ui-serif, Georgia, serif; font-size: 22px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: -0.005em; } .eyebrow { color: var(--docent-accent); font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 0.24em; } .body { color: oklch(87% 0.016 70); } .button { border-radius: 999px; letter-spacing: 0.02em; } .button.primary { padding-inline: 18px; } .marks i[data-done] { background: var(--docent-accent); }
